entities.name: Mobility History Information Storage
entities.description: Specifies how the mobility history information is stored by the UE, covering RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_CONNECTED states.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Radio Resource Control idle state where UE monitors paging and performs cell selection.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: Radio Resource Control inactive state where UE maintains connection context but doesn't have active data transfer.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: Radio Resource Control connected state where UE has active connection with the network.

relations.description: Mobility history storage procedure covers UE behavior in RRC_IDLE state.
Mobility history storage procedure covers UE behavior in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Mobility history storage procedure covers UE behavior in RRC_CONNECTED state.
